description: This Java class, FreeTextDosingInstructions, extends BaseDosingInstructions and encapsulates free-text dosing instructions for drug orders within the OpenMRS medical record system. It provides methods to set, get, and validate the instructions, as well as to retrieve instructions in string form or as a DosingInstructions object.

classes.name: FreeTextDosingInstructions
classes.description: A class representing free-text dosing instructions, extending BaseDosingInstructions, used in the OpenMRS system to handle custom dosing instructions for drug orders.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns the current instructions as a string, localized if necessary.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Sets the dosing instructions on a given DrugOrder object.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves a DosingInstructions object from a DrugOrder, ensuring the dosing type matches.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that the dosing instructions are not empty for the free-text dosing type.
